title: campyloneurum repens
intro: Campyloneurum repens, commonly known as False Mast, is a type of fern native to South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Campyloneurum repens include its antispasmodic and expectorant effects, helping to ease coughs and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
